title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - SectionOfLine
description: Section Of Line (era:SectionOfLine's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A section of line means the part of line between adjacent operational points and may consist of several tracks. Inherits attributes from era:InfrastructureElement/era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SectionOfLine'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

existOpeningHoursLimitation.description: Property. Indicate, if there are any opening hours of the section of a line or Tunnel or Bridge.

existRestrictedDangerousGood.description: Property. Indicate, if there are any limits on transportation of dangerous goods.

existRestrictedPeriodOfTimeDangerousGood.description: Property. Indicate, if there are any limits on specific time of a day for transport of dangerous goods.

existenceOfIndustrialRisk.description: Property. Indication that the full section of line (or a part of it) it is identified by the Infrastructure Managers (and communicated to the RU) where drivers are not supposed to get off the locomotive. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.1.1)

hasConnectingIM.description: Property. Indicates whether any neighbouring section of line belongs to different Infrastructure Manager

hasNoiseLevelLimit.description: Property. Indicate, if there are any limits on noise levels.

lengthOfSectionOfLine.description: Property. Length between operational points at start and end of section of line. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.5)

loadingGauge.description: Property. Maximum physical dimensions (height and width) to which an open rail wagon can be loaded

maxAxleLoadOfSoL.description: Property. Maximum permitted axle load, given in tons.

maxNoiseLevelOfSoL.description: Property. Maximum allowed noise level in decibels (dB).

maximumPermittedMeterLoad.description: Property. Maximum permitted meter load, given in tons

maximumTrainLength.description: Property. Maximum train length allowed on a line or section

nationalLine.description:
Relationship. Indicates a relationship with a national railway line at a specific kilometer point.
For a Section of Line: unique line identification or unique line number within Member State. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.2)

opEnd.description: Relationship. Operational point at the end of section of line (kilometres increasing from start OP to the end OP). (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.4)

opStart.description: Relationship. Operational point at the start of section of line (kilometres increasing from start OP to the end OP). (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.3)

openingHoursLimitation.description: Property. Opening hours of the section of a line or tunnel or a bridge

operationalRegimeType.description: Property. Double track type. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.1.3) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Operational regime types' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/operational-regime-types/OperationalRegimeTypes), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

restrictedDangerousGood.description: Property. Description of the type of dangerous good that are not allowed in the tunnel

restrictedPeriodOfTimeDangerousGood.description: Property. Describes the period of time for which the transport of dangerous goods is not allowed in the Section of Line

solNature.description: Property. Kind of section of line expressing size of presented data which depends on fact whether it connects OPs generated by division of a big node into several OPs or not. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.6) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Section of Line Natures' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/sol-natures/SoLNatures), 2 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

specializedInfrastructure.description: Property. Special type of service on a line or a section of a line.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Indicates that an infrastructure element belongs to a certain subset that contains common characteristics. Target type (CommonCharacteristicsSubset) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.

canonicalURI.description:
Property. The canonical URI is defined for each instance of an Infrastructure element, e.g. section of line, operational point, track, tunnel, siding.
Objects of the infrastructure generated through RML mappings include (when provided) their validity start and end dates. With its identifier, plus all identifiers of its "parent" elements, and its validity dates, a hash URI is generated.
The canonical URI is the element's URI with its identifiers and without the validity dates. All of the hash URIs of an element point to its canonical URI.
Additionally, SoLs point to the canonical URIs of their start OP and end OP.

exemptSpecialVehiclesFromATO.description: Property. Indicates whether special vehicles are exempted from the need to install ATO (Automatic Train Operation) for this infrastructure element.

exemptSpecialVehiclesFromETCS.description: Property. Indicates whether special vehicles are exempted from the need to install ETCS (European Train Control System) for this infrastructure element.

exemptSpecialVehiclesFromRMR.description: Property. Indicates whether special vehicles are exempted from the need to install RMR (Railway Mobile Radio) for this infrastructure element.

items.description:
Relationship. Indicates that an infrastructure element is composed of one or more other (distinct) infrastructure elements.
This property is used to represent part-whole relationships between infrastructure elements.
An element cannot be a part of itself.

hasPart.description:
Relationship. Indicates that an infrastructure element is composed of one or more other (distinct) infrastructure elements.
This property is used to represent part-whole relationships between infrastructure elements.
An element cannot be a part of itself.

hashSource.description: Property. This property indicates for each infrastructure element, the source, i.e. the identifier  or key that was input to the hash function in order to generate the hash value that is part of the hash URI.

inCountry.description: Property. Indicates the country in which an entity resides. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

infrastructureManager.description: Relationship. Relates a subset with common characteristics with its IM, represented by an instance of organisation role that points to the "infrastructure manager" concept in the taxonomy.

items.description:
Relationship. Indicates that an infrastructure element is a part of another (distinct) infrastructure element.
An element cannot be part of itself.
This property is the inverse of era:hasPart and represents the partial or whole-part relationship between infrastructure elements.

isPartOf.description:
Relationship. Indicates that an infrastructure element is a part of another (distinct) infrastructure element.
An element cannot be part of itself.
This property is the inverse of era:hasPart and represents the partial or whole-part relationship between infrastructure elements.

netReference.description: Relationship. The reference that a physical infrastructure element has it on the topology. It may be used to define the positioning or a representation as a point, line or area

operatingLanguage.description: Property. The language or languages used in daily operation by infrastructure manager and published in its Network Statement, for the communication of operational or safety related messages between the staff of the infrastructure manager and the railway undertaking. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.1.2, 1.2.0.0.0.8) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Language' SKOS concept scheme (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/language), 26 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

parameterApplicability.description: Relationship. Relates an infrastructure element or a common characteristics subset with the applicability of a certain parameter. Target type (ParameterApplicability) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.

primaryLocation.description: Relationship. Primary location code developed for information exchange in accordance with the TSIs relating to the telematics applications subsystem. (RINF register parameter index: 1.2.0.0.0.3)

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
